meta_title: Tyne Gardens Gardening | Professional Gardener Newcastle
meta_description: Tyne Gardens Gardening Services in Newcastle. Expert garden maintenance, design, and landscaping. Local family business. Call 07871 883022 for a free quote.
hero_eyebrow: Local Family Business — 12+ Years in Gateshead & Newcastle
hero_subhead: From overgrown borders to beautiful outdoor spaces. We handle everything from weekly maintenance to full landscaping projects.
services_heading: Complete Gardening Services Across Tyne & Wear
services_subhead: Whether you need regular maintenance or a complete garden overhaul, we've got the expertise and equipment to deliver.

services.title: Regular Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Weekly or fortnightly visits for hedge trimming, lawn care, weeding, and seasonal planting. Keep your garden looking sharp year-round without lifting a finger.

services.title: Garden Design & Landscaping
services.desc: Full design service from sketch to completion. We create functional, beautiful outdoor spaces tailored to your style and budget—patios, raised beds, pathways, and planting schemes included.

services.title: Lawn Care & Treatment
services.desc: Professional lawn feeding, moss control, and scarification to restore colour and density. We can also lay new turf or overseed patches for a pristine finish.

services.title: Tree & Shrub Pruning
services.desc: Expert trimming and shaping of trees, hedges, and shrubs. We work safely at height and remove waste responsibly, keeping your garden open and light.

services.title: Garden Clearance & Tidy-Ups
services.desc: Overgrown garden? We clear brambles, dead wood, and debris, then haul everything away. Your garden is left clean, safe, and ready for replanting.

services.title: Seasonal Planting & Bedding
services.desc: Spring bedding, summer colour schemes, and winter interest plantings. We source quality plants and handle all preparation and aftercare.

about_pullquote: A tidy garden isn't a luxury—it's where life happens.
about_para_1: Tyne Gardens was founded on a simple idea: every home deserves an outdoor space that works hard and looks great. Over 12 years, we've grown from a one-man operation to a small, trusted team serving Gateshead, Newcastle, and across Tyne & Wear. We've maintained hundreds of gardens through every season, and we know what it takes to keep plants healthy and borders beautiful.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we listen. We're not here to oversell big projects or leave you with a bill you weren't expecting. We show up on time, do honest work, and treat your garden like it matters—because it does. Repeat clients make up 70% of our work, and that's something we're genuinely proud of.
reviews_heading: What Gateshead & Newcastle Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had three quotes for a full garden overhaul and Tyne Gardens was reasonable and reliable. They designed a new patio layout, laid turf, and planted borders. Finished on time and cleaned up after themselves. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Regular maintenance every two weeks. Sean and the team are punctual, professional, and don't fuss about small jobs. Garden looks immaculate year-round. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: Jennifer H.

reviews.text: Absolute lifesaver. Cleared our jungle of a back garden in one day. Very competitive quote, friendly lads, and they even advised on what to plant next. Will definitely have them back.
reviews.author: David M.
